Subject: Account mapping: Gateway Solutions / MidMarket West overlap

Hi Ellen / Gateway Partnerships team —

Quick note: during a recent pipeline scrub we discovered ~18 MidMarket West accounts that both your partner SDRs and our direct SDRs have active outreach against. A few of these are in active POC and one shows as a near-term renewal (Q3). We want to avoid confusing customers and make sure motions are aligned.

Can we align on a simple account-claim approach for this territory while we define a longer-term GTM playbook? My proposed principles:
- Preserve existing active POCs (do not reassign until closed)
- If both sides have light outreach (cold activity), prioritize partner ownership when >3 partner touches in last 90 days
- For contested renewals, escalate to alliance owners for a joint outreach plan

I'd like to set a 30-minute alignment call this week to share a proposed mapping and get your input. If you prefer, I can send an initial matrix first.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes

Ellen / Camila —

Thanks for the quick responses. I’ll join the call. To keep this focused, propose we operate by a short set of tie-break rules while we build a partner GTM playbook:
1) Active POC / active SOW stays with the active motion owner
2) If neither side has an active POC, ownership goes to the party with the higher number of meaningful touches in the last 90 days (>=3)
3) For prospects with product integrations in scope, prioritize the partner unless the partner requests us to own outreach
4) Any account with open pricing/contract negotiation is escalated to Alliances and Sales leadership for decision

Camila — can you prepare a simple matrix with status (POC/SOW/Touches/Last contact) and share a Drive link? Marissa, Tessa — please be ready to map the regional reps and list any near-term renewals that might be impacted.

Goal for Wed: agree ownership for the 18 accounts, commit to owner for 60 days, and schedule joint outreach for the top 5.

Jonas Weber
